rows.jp: 「わかりましたよ、先輩……じゃあですね、かわりに」
rows.en: “All right, Mimi... then, in return...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Understood, Senpai. Then, instead of that..."

rows.jp: 「なぁに？」
rows.en: “What is it?”

ghs.en: Misato: "Wha-at?"

rows.jp: 「エッチなことって、したことあります？」
rows.en: “Have you ever... done it?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Sexual things, so to say, have you ever done any?"

rows.jp: 「文脈違うじゃないですか！」
rows.en: “That’s got nothing to do with what we were talking about!”

ghs.en: Misato: "Is this not the wrong context now!"

rows.jp: 「先輩っていいなって思ってたんです」
rows.en: “I always thought you were kind of great.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Because I thought, with Senpai it would be fine."

rows.jp: 「あの……桜舞う入学式の日、弟が死んで目的を見失った俺を救い出してくれた先輩の思い出の一言が」
rows.en: “I mean... on the day of the entrance ceremony, with cherry blossoms in the air, after my little brother died and left me without a purpose, you saved me with those unforgettable words—”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Well... I still remember the few words with which you saved me, Senpai, on that school opening ceremony day of the fluttering cherry blossoms, when I had lost sight of all purpose over the death of my little brother..."

rows.jp: 「だまされません、そんな最大瞬間風速的恋愛オーラにはだまされません！」
rows.en: “I'm not falling for that! Not for some romantic aura that peaks for one instant and blows over!”

ghs.en: Misato: "It shall not deceive me! That Passionate Aura at maximum momentary wind velocity shall not deceive me!"

rows.jp: 「だいたい弟なんていないでしょ！」
rows.en: “Besides, you don’t even have a younger brother!”

ghs.en: Misato: "Besides, you do not have a younger brother!"

rows.jp: 「白球にかけた一夏、俺はアイツから逃げるために、野球をやめたつもりでした」
rows.en: “That summer, I gave everything I had to baseball. I thought I'd quit the game to get away from him.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That one Summer staked on the stitched ball, when for the sake of finally escaping 'him', I intended to give up baseball..."

rows.jp: 「違う違う、野球は違う」
rows.en: “No, no, baseball has nothing to do with this.”

ghs.en: Misato: "Wrong, wrong! Baseball is wrong!"

rows.jp: 「といいますか、すごくＨなこと考えてませんか？」
rows.en: “More to the point, aren’t you thinking something extremely dirty right now?”

ghs.en: Misato: "But more like, are you really thinking of perverted things, are you?"

rows.jp: 「いやー」
rows.en: “Well...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Welll..."

rows.jp: 「食欲が満たされたから、あとは性欲かなって」
rows.en: “I'd satisfied my appetite, so I figured my sex drive came next.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "After the physical hunger is satisfied, there remains the libido, I think."

rows.jp: 「らりほー！」
rows.en: “Lali-ho!”

ghs.en: Misato: "Rarihooo!"

rows.jp: 先輩は窓から叫んだ。
rows.en: Mimi shouted out the window.

ghs.en: A shout out from the window by Senpai.

rows.jp: 「それ以上近寄ったら……舌を噛んで死にます」
rows.en: “Come any closer... and I'll bite my tongue and kill myself.”

ghs.en: Misato: "If you approach me any more... I will swallow my tongue and die!"

rows.jp: 「そ、そんなにイヤなのですかー！？」
rows.en: “Y-you hate the idea that much?!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You-, dislike this that muuuch?!"

rows.jp: 泣きそう。
rows.en: I was ready to cry.

ghs.en: It's to cry.

rows.jp: やっぱ人間容姿だ。
rows.en: So looks were everything after all.

ghs.en: I knew it, humans are their looks.

rows.jp: 白髪の醜悪ボーイには、人並みの恋愛など許されないのだ。
rows.en: A hideous white-haired boy like me wasn't allowed a normal love life.

ghs.en: ordinary things like love are not allowed to this boy with the ugly white hair.

rows.jp: でも土下座したらＨさせてくれないかな先輩。
rows.en: Still, maybe Mimi would sleep with me if I got down on my knees and begged.

ghs.en: But maybe, Senpai will concede me my perversions, if I genuflect.

rows.jp: もう一押しの気がする。
rows.en: I had a feeling one more push would do it.

ghs.en: I feel like one more try.

rows.jp: 迫る
rows.en: Make a move

rows.jp: ボケる
rows.en: Crack a joke
